title: Orders API pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff after deploy
description: The orders-api rollout to v3.8.1 is stuck: new pods are failing to start and are cycling between ErrImagePull and ImagePullBackOff. Old pods are still serving traffic but the deployment cannot progress and no further scaling is possible.
